plans.name: rn-ncm-byte-budget-fix
plans.overview: Repair the deterministic NCM recall byte-budget scan and retain its lower-ranked-candidate regression.

todos.content: Confirm the frozen oversized-ranked-candidate case fails against the pre-fix core behavior and record the exact UTF-8 byte budget oracle.
Make the smallest core recall correction so an oversized ranked row cannot hide later rows that fit, while preserving truncation and text-integrity semantics.
Run the focused core regression and hand its accepted result to the NCM integration tests, build and 100-trial verification gates.

plans.name: rn-ncm-proof-retry
plans.overview: Repair transient NCM instance-proof negative caching so a fail-once readiness proof can recover safely.

todos.content: Exercise a fail-once instance-proof provider and demonstrate that cached None suppresses a later admissible delivery on the same daemon.
Replace transient negative caching with a bounded retry or truthful retryable outcome while preserving cancellation, shutdown and fail-closed behavior.
Run fail-once, permanent-failure, restart and cancellation regressions and hand the accepted result to NCM tests, build and reliability verification.

plans.name: rn-ncm-real-fix
plans.overview: Repair the first demonstrated real-worker NCM recall loss without weakening ordering, scope or delivery contracts.

todos.content: Implement the smallest correction at the stage-trace owner identified by rn-ncm-stage-trace.
Show the pinned intermittent workload failing before the correction and passing after it across worker restart, replay, cancellation and concurrent observation boundaries.
Return the exact repair diff and focused filters so rn-ncm-tests, rn-build and the 100-trial NCM verification can consume the same artifact.

plans.name: rn-ncm-reproduce
plans.overview: Reproduce intermittent NCM recall with stage-by-stage evidence

todos.content: Recover the original 2-of-4 versus 4-of-4 workload and verify which items were required under its limits and scope.
Reproduce cold, warm, restart and load cases with pinned real worker/model; identify the first stage losing required data.
Reduce a failing case into a deterministic regression or controlled fault/scheduling test with a demonstrated failing baseline.

plans.name: rn-ncm-stage-trace
plans.overview: Localize the intermittent real-worker NCM recall loss with stage receipts before assigning a repair.

todos.content: Run the pinned original 2-of-4 journey and its cold, warm, restart and concurrent variants with correlation IDs at every admitted stage.
Compare host admission, journal sequence, ACK/watermark, worker readiness, common recall, adapter reconstruction, filtering and final delivery to identify the first missing required item.
Publish an evidence-backed repair seam or a narrowly bounded instrumentation blocker; do not infer causality from a passing rerun.

plans.name: rn-ncm-tests
plans.overview: Preserve NCM behavior while Native is restored. Preserve the complete original upstream Native implementation from 570 and its operation boundaries.

todos.content: Preserve NCM behavior while Native is restored and return the required reviewable evidence.

plans.name: rn-privacy-restore
plans.overview: Revalidate the privacy restoration gate at the PR707 baseline and route any real mismatch to its exact product owner.

todos.content: Record detector equality and typed history admission revalidation for 570; return a bounded fix handoff only if needed.

plans.name: rn-privacy-trace-id
plans.overview: Accept the persisted recall explain-trace identity repair and prove hostile provider IDs never survive into stored traces.

todos.content: Review the host-context and registry changes that project provider candidate identities before explain-trace serialization.
Exercise admission denial, deduplication, budget exclusion, hydration exclusion and final withholding with hostile IDs, then inspect serialized and reopened trace rows.
Publish the accepted raw-ID absence and reconciliation evidence so rn-privacy-restore can revalidate the complete privacy boundary.

plans.name: rn-provider-semantics
plans.overview: Make NCM provider-side temporal, scope, exclusion and budget semantics explicit before the candidate build.

todos.content: Compare provider admission and reconstruction against the accepted contract for all seven scope fields, temporal validity, provenance, exclusions and UTF-8 budgets.
Apply only demonstrated provider-side corrections in the common adapter and source-binding projection, preserving opaque identity and canonical host ownership.
Record focused downstream filters and contract evidence for NCM tests and the candidate build; do not claim real-worker reliability here.

plans.name: rn-semantic-acquisition-fix

todos.content: Reproduce fresh-profile, provisioned-profile and restart behavior using the real CLI and strict semantic requests.
Trace artifact acquisition, generation projection, calibration persistence and scoped query-authority activation to the first missing transition.
Publish the responsible setup or code seam, negative controls and failing acceptance case before repair.

plans.name: rn-semantic-runtime-dynamic
plans.overview: Execute the pinned semantic lifecycle against a real candidate runtime and localize the unavailable-to-ready transition.

todos.content: Use the pinned Jina fixture to exercise fresh, acquisition, projection, calibration, activation, strict query and restart states through the real CLI/runtime.
Run missing, corrupt, mismatched, offline, cancellation, source-update and same-checkout recovery controls with exact artifact/generation identities.
Identify the first missing transition and release a bounded acquisition/serving fix handoff before any semantic code fix or verification claim.

plans.name: rn-semantic-serving-fix
plans.overview: Repair the diagnosed semantic query-serving transition while preserving strict mode and truthful hybrid fallback.

todos.content: Implement the smallest correction at the code-index/query serving boundary identified by rn-semantic-runtime-dynamic.
Verify frozen paraphrase and negative controls use real semantic evidence and never pass through lexical-only output or an unavailable authority.
Return source diff, lifecycle compatibility, focused filters and build/semantic-verification inputs without changing acquisition ownership.
